title: Compact Incident Insight & Alert Setup Wizard (Console)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Design a compact incident insight panel and a guided 'Alert & SLO Setup' wizard inside Redwood Console that reduces cognitive load for on-call engineers and surface postmortem links and handoff info directly in incident cards. This ticket covers wireframes, high-fidelity prototype, and a small usability pass for the flow: create alert -> attach SLO -> define escalation/on-call handoff -> link postmortem artifacts and runbooks. Success metrics: reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) by 10% on pilot routes, 80% completion rate for first-time alert creators in usability testing, and <2 minutes median time to surface postmortem link after incident closure.
acceptance_criteria: Compact incident card shows: summary, current status, active alerts, linked SLOs, on-call owner, quick actions (acknowledge, reassign), and persistent postmortem link if present.
Alert & SLO Setup wizard guides users through: selecting metric/source, choosing threshold, picking SLO target, default escalation policy, and optional postmortem runbook link.
Wizard provides sensible defaults based on route history and recommended SLO profiles; advanced fields are collapsed by default.
Prototype accessible from Console top nav and via the route detail page; keyboard navigable and meets WCAG 2.1 AA for contrast and focus order.
Annotated Figma file and PRD link provided; design reviewed by PM and engineering and ready for handoff to FE with specs.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff sketch session with PM (Ravi Patel) and SRE (Dana Liu). We agreed to prioritize a compact summary card rather than a full-page incident viewer for faster acknowledgements.

2026-02-20 - Liam Chen: Wireframes uploaded to Figma. Main trade-off discussed: how many SLO details to surface on the card before it overwhelms the view. Decided to show short metrics (e.g., current burn rate) and a link to expanded SLO view.

2026-02-25 - Design critique (all-hands): Feedback to add explicit 'handoff' timestamp and allow users to pin a postmortem link during incident creation. PM asked for integration point with Confluence and GitHub; we annotated API placeholders in PRD.

2026-03-02 - Usability test (5 participants): Observed users expect escalation defaults to be suggested based on previous rules; some confusion around 'recommended SLO' label. Action: rename to 'Suggested SLO profile' and add inline tooltip.

2026-03-07 - Engineering review (Sean Rodriguez, frontend): Flagged performance concern for card that fetches many linked artifacts; agreed to lazy-load postmortem metadata and cache signatures in route metadata. Also requested JSON shape for handoff card; awaiting product confirmation.
2026-03-10 - Ava Martinez: Updated Figma with high-fidelity mockups and included keyboard flows. Leaving for final PM review before generating dev tickets and a Github design spec PR.
notes: Design decision: collapse advanced notification options behind 'Advanced' toggle to keep first-time flow short.
Performance mitigation: lazy-load postmortem link metadata and show placeholder skeleton in card.
Integration: add optional Confluence/GitHub URL field in wizard and map to 'postmortem_link' on incident close API.
Next steps: split into two FE stories (card + wizard), include QA checklist for accessibility, and schedule handoff meeting with ENG on 2026-03-12.
